envelope.name: ComplaiEventEnvelope
envelope.description: The canonical event format that unifies all Complai tools. Every event flowing between Sift, Moment, and Forge is wrapped in this envelope.

tools.name: Sift
tools.description: Upstream domain modeling tool that captures the initial domain exploration — bounded contexts, aggregates, commands, events, value objects, invariants, policies, and sagas. Publishes structured building block events that Moment imports.

tools.name: Moment
tools.description: Transforms .moment specification files into typed TypeScript implementations, Gherkin test scenarios, and specification documents. Imports Sift's domain events and enriches them with temporal modeling — flows, crossings, projections, and saga orchestration.

tools.name: Facet
tools.description: Interactive visualization and simulation engine for domain flows. Consumes Moment's simulation scenarios (facet.json) to render event timelines, causation chains, crossing contracts, and branch paths — letting you test your domain model before writing implementation code.

tools.name: Forge
tools.description: Gets your project into motion. Consumes Moment's typed artifacts and simulation scenarios to bootstrap project structure, wire up bounded contexts, and establish the development workflow.

dataFlow.description: Sift publishes building block events that Moment imports as specification input
Moment generates Facet-compatible simulation scenarios with synthetic events, causation chains, and branch paths for visual validation
Moment produces typed artifacts and reconciliation events that Forge consumes to bootstrap project structure
